close_reason: Fixed in commit 687f8be. Added walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint + validate_metadata_filter helpers that walk the Filter<MetadataFilterCondition> tree (recursing through FilterOperator AND/OR/NOT) and return invalidArguments when any leaf has relatedIds=Some(...) and relatedType=None. Validation runs in both handle_metadata_query and handle_metadata_query_changes shims before delegating to the generic. Added 4 unit tests covering leaf, nested-OR, positive control, and the /queryChanges parallel path. All 36 tests pass; clippy clean.
description:
Per draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01 §3.4.1: 'relatedIds MUST only be specified when relatedType is also specified... if relatedIds is specified without relatedType, the server MUST reject the query with an invalidArguments error'.

The generic jmap_server::handlers::handle_query is unaware of this Metadata-specific cross-field constraint — it just parses Filter then hands it to backend.query_objects. Validation must land in the metadata-server handler shim (handle_metadata_query and handle_metadata_query_changes) before delegating to the generic.

Add cross-field validation that walks the MetadataFilterCondition tree (including nested FilterOperator branches) and returns invalidArguments when any leaf has relatedIds=Some(...) and relatedType=None.

Decomposed from JMAP-ayoz.6.
title: Metadata/query handler: validate relatedIds-without-relatedType → invalidArguments
